### 【主干结构】
- 让步状语从句：Whatever the final answer to the water crisis may be
- 主句：it is evident that ...
  - 形式主语：it
  - 谓语：is
  - 表语：evident
  - 真正主语：that within the High Plains, irrigation water will never again be the abundant, inexpensive resource (that) it was during the agricultural boom years of the mid-twentieth century.

### 【主谓一致】
从句主语 'the final answer' 单数，谓语 'may be' 单数。
主句主语 'it' 单数，谓语 'is' 单数。
that 从句主语 'irrigation water' 单数，谓语 'will be' 单数。

### 【动词时态与原形】
从句 'may be' 使用情态动词+原形。
主句 'is' 使用一般现在时。
that 从句 'will be' 使用一般将来时。
'was' 使用一般过去时。

### 【从句剖析】
1. 'Whatever the final answer to the water crisis may be': 让步状语从句。
2. 'that within the High Plains, irrigation water will never again be the abundant, inexpensive resource ...': 主语从句，作 evident 的真正主语。
3. '(that) it was during the agricultural boom years of the mid-twentieth century': 定语从句，修饰 resource，省略了关系代词。

### 【非谓语动词】
无。

### 【修饰语细分】
- 'to the water crisis': 定语，修饰 answer
- 'within the High Plains': 状语，修饰 be
- 'during the agricultural boom years of the mid-twentieth century': 状语，修饰 was
